name: Mining Clock
description: Analog clock with live miner hashrate and power rings for BFM100
config_help:
Reads one miner's BOS REST API. Only Braiins OS miners serve this API.

**The miner this display belongs to:** bind **Local BOS token** to the *Local BOS API* account and keep the Miner URL at `http://localhost/api/v1`. No password is needed, and the widget keeps working after you change the miner password.

**Another miner on your network:** set the Miner URL to that miner's API, for example `http://10.0.0.5/api/v1`, and bind **Remote miner login** to an account holding that miner's password. The username is always `root`. Leave Local BOS token unbound.

Bind exactly one of the two accounts. With neither the widget asks you to bind one; with both it asks you to choose.

miner_url.name: Miner URL
miner_url.description: BOS REST API base URL of a remote miner, e.g. http://10.0.0.5/api/v1. Used only with Remote miner login; keep http://localhost/api/v1 for this display's miner.

show_date.name: Show date
show_date.description: Display the date inside the analog dial

timezone_override.name: Timezone
timezone_override.description: Timezone to display the clock in. Defaults to the system timezone.

bos_local.label: Local BOS token
bos_local.description: For the miner this display belongs to. Bind the Local BOS API account; the Miner URL is then ignored. Leave Remote miner login unbound.

bos_remote.label: Remote miner login
bos_remote.description: For a miner elsewhere on your network. Bind an account with the miner's password; the username is always root. Set the Miner URL to its API. Leave Local BOS token unbound.
